The movement must be interchangeablewithout stopping the program

Show that your robot can perform the following using color sensor:
1. When color sensor detects not green, the robot will not move and stay stationary.
2. When color detects green, the robot will move forward at the speed of 100.

Hint:
1. Return Color Value / Return Color Name
